__ANSWER___Overview___Study_at_a_Glance: ▸ Purpose of this workbook: Each sheet directly answers one of the 6 research questions about student follow-up behaviour in the VR sorting algorithm platform.
▸ 18 students: Akhil, Anusha, Bindu, Gautam, Karthik, Karthikeya, Meghana, Phani, Priya, Radha, Revanth, Rushitha, Sarath, ShivRam, Swetha, Venkat, Vignesh, Yashwanth.
▸ 271 total follow-up questions: Across 308 required question slots. 45 slots (14.6%) had mixed follow-up type sequences. 143 were CL, 58 EX, 35 SM, 21 SA, 6 CO, 8 other.
▸ Key finding: Implementation stage drives the most follow-up activity; Reflection the least. Students are most exploratory during Analyzing and most confused during Exploration.
▸ How to navigate: Go to each Q-sheet for full data. The summary answer box at the top of each sheet gives the direct answer. Scroll down for the full tables and heatmaps.
